headline: Ways to work together

offers.title: Outcome based coaching
offers.body: We agree on the outcomes you want to achieve together and draft a personal program for you. Clients have used coaching for anything from doubling revenue to creating more peace and joy in their day.

offers.title: Retained Advisory
offers.body: Typically six months. I am your partner in creating the outcomes that matter to you. Specific arrangements can be made to serve your current needs and the season of your business.

offers.title: Deep Day
offers.body: Six to eight hours, off-site or on-site in your office. We resolve the biggest obstacles for your business & personal growth. Can be used for crisis intervention.

offers.title: Retreats in Switzerland and Europe
offers.body: Small-group retreats for founders who need a creative space to access their best thinking, build a future worth creating, and nourish their bodies.

offers.title: Team Trainings & Workshops
offers.body: Custom trainings and workshops to serve the development of key skills and performance drivers in your team. On request. Contact me directly, moritz@lembertstudio.com

closing: Engagements are scoped to the situation and what is most improtant to you. We agree on that together before any proposal.
